title: Functional individual Ziplock bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung
text:
Functional individual Ziplock bag organizers to put in a drawer or on a counter; cannot be hung. I am a bit disappointed in this set. There are four separate bag organizers with one each for quart, gallon, sandwich, and snack bags. Since the compartments are labeled, most people would not use them to store other items like garlic, onions, socks, individually wrapped tea bags, etc. In fact, these would be better for that because the compartments (except for the quart ones) have a very wide opening.

Since this is not one unit, it cannot be hung on the wall. Also, there are no felt feet to prevent movement or scratches for when it is placed on the counter or in a drawer. The beauty of this design is that each compartment can be configured anyway one desires. They can go in several separate drawers or in an L shape in one drawer, or side-by-side, etc.

It does keep all my plastic bags in order. Overall, this is a nicely made organizer that does away with all those squished and ugly boxes in my cabinets. I do wish the entry holes were smaller and that it had felt feet.

The current price of $29.99 is competitively priced for this. There are many other options available for organizers such as this [[ASIN:B09KMNHM2J one]] or this [[ASIN:B09VGP1WRL one]]. For one full unit only, then I recommend this [[ASIN:B09RF759BM rustic organizer]]. For a more modern look, I recommend this [[ASIN:B09WN5PZ6Q one]]. For a larger unit that has room for foil and plastic wrap, then I highly recommend this [[ASIN:B0B1TPD21S one]]. I tried all of these and the style purchased is based on what one desires. I personally like these other ones a little better than this one.
